name: The Perfectly Perfect Duo
caption: The promotion's own Tag Team Champions, retaining the title against a rival team at the promotion's own second pay-per-view with their manager at ringside.

tenures.source: The promotion's own broadcasts, June and July 1999.

identity.note: Name collision only, against tag teams of the same name in two unrelated promotions; no shared operator, roster or storyline evidence.

name: Dark Justice
caption: A tag team that opened the promotion's own second pay-per-view with a pinfall win, per its own members' handler's repeated newsgroup credits through the rest of 1999.

tenures.source: The promotion's own second pay-per-view (26 June 1999) and a member's own handler's repeated newsgroup credits through the rest of 1999.

identity.note: Name collision only, against tag teams of the same name in two unrelated promotions, one of them closed only weeks before this billing's own first appearance; that promotion's own surviving text does not name its Dark Justice's members, so no shared-member evidence links the two despite the coincidence in timing.

name: Gods Justice
caption: Opened the promotion's own second pay-per-view on the losing end of a pinfall.

tenures.source: The promotion's own second pay-per-view, 26 June 1999.

name: Sons of Savagery
caption: Challenged unsuccessfully for the promotion's own Tag Team Championship at the promotion's own second pay-per-view.

tenures.source: The promotion's own second pay-per-view, 26 June 1999.
